entries.title: Psalms 38:1
segments: A Psalm of David, to bring to remembrance. O LORD, do not rebuke me in Your wrath; neither chasten me in Your fury.

entries.title: Psalms 38:2
segments: For Your arrows stick fast in me, and Your hand presses heavily on me.

entries.title: Psalms 38:3
segments: [There is] no soundness in my flesh because of Your anger; nor rest in my bones because of my sin.

entries.title: Psalms 38:4
segments: For my iniquities have gone over my head; like a heavy burden they are too heavy for me.

entries.title: Psalms 38:5
segments: My wounds have putrefied [and] rotted, because of my foolishness.

entries.title: Psalms 38:6
segments: I am troubled; I am bowed down greatly; I go mourning all the day long.

entries.title: Psalms 38:7
segments: For my loins are filled with a burning; and there [is] no soundness in my flesh.

entries.title: Psalms 38:8
segments: I am feeble and painfully broken; I have roared because of the groanings of my heart.

entries.title: Psalms 38:9
segments: My Lord, all my desire [is] before You; and my sighing is not hidden from You.

entries.title: Psalms 38:10
segments: My heart pants; my strength fails me; as for the light of my eyes, it also is gone from me.

entries.title: Psalms 38:11
segments: My lovers and my friends stand apart from my plague; and my neighbors stand far off.

entries.title: Psalms 38:12
segments: And those who seek my life lay snares [for me]; and those who seek my hurt speak sly things, and utter deceits all the day long.

entries.title: Psalms 38:13
segments: But like a deaf one, I do not hear; and I [am] like a dumb one who opens not his mouth.

entries.title: Psalms 38:14
segments: And I am as a man who hears not, and in whose mouth [are] no reproofs.

entries.title: Psalms 38:15
segments: For in You, O LORD, do I hope; You will hear, O LORD my God.

entries.title: Psalms 38:16
segments: For I said, [Hear me], lest they rejoice over me; when my foot slips, they magnify themselves against me.

entries.title: Psalms 38:17
segments: For I [am] ready to fall, and my pain [is] always before me.

entries.title: Psalms 38:18
segments: For I will declare my iniquity; I am anxious from my sin.

entries.title: Psalms 38:19
segments: And my enemies [are] lively; they are strong; and my haters increase [by] deception.

entries.title: Psalms 38:20
segments: And those who give evil for good oppose me, because I follow good.

entries.title: Psalms 38:21
segments: Forsake me not, O LORD; O my God, be not far from me.

entries.title: Psalms 38:22
segments: Make haste to help me, O my LORD, my salvation.
